futureVision.goal: Evolve KickFix from a single-kick analyzer into a general martial-arts coaching platform for individual techniques, combinations, and complete forms/patterns.
principles: Build and validate single techniques before combining them into sequences.
Separate movement detection/segmentation from biomechanical scoring.
Represent techniques and sequences as data-driven definitions instead of duplicating analyzer code.
Give one prioritized correction at a time; do not overwhelm beginners.
Use body-relative spatial thresholds and timestamp-based temporal thresholds.
Never claim pose landmarks measure impact force, muscle activation, or hidden joint rotation directly.
Design around one-camera limits: occlusion, turns away from camera, mirrored front camera, variable FPS, and incomplete landmarks.

movementPrimitive.definition: A versioned semantic technique that references separate detector, scorer, and cue-set definitions; detection and scoring must not be coupled.
prohibitedMeasurements: absolute physical speed from monocular depth

primitiveEvent.definition: The stable contract emitted by a streaming detector and consumed by sequence and scoring engines.

sequenceEngine.definition: A monotonic-timestamp state machine that consumes committed primitive events, handles overlap/repetition, validates transitions, and rejects stale async results.

guidedCoach.definition: A deterministic voice/visual controller that coordinates cue completion, observation gates, confidence, endpoint holds, retries, pause/resume, and camera reacquisition.
guidedCoach.retryPolicy: After two unsuccessful retries, offer repeat demonstration, adjust camera, retry, skip, or end; uncertainty is not failure.

sharedResult.scoreRule: Emit a numeric score only when observable weighted coverage meets the scorer's minimum; missing evidence never deducts points.
sharedResult.compatibilityRule: Keep existing kicks/kick_frames unchanged and adapt them for generalized reads; never insert punches, blocks, combos, or forms into kicks.

rules: A criterion may fail only when its evidence is observable.
Low confidence becomes uncertain/tracking_lost/unsupported_view, not poor technique.
Interpolated landmarks may preserve segmentation continuity but cannot pass scoring criteria or endpoint holds.
Thresholds are versioned per primitive, phase, view, and landmark set.

measurementPolicy.imageSpace: Use normalized image coordinates for framing and visible displacement, normalized to stable body references from the same frame/view.
measurementPolicy.worldSpace: Treat MediaPipe world coordinates as monocular estimates, not ground-truth metric capture. Do not report absolute speed, impact, contact, or hidden rotation from them.
measurementPolicy.sourceSelection: Each criterion declares one primary coordinate source and supported view. Conflicting sources produce uncertain/unobservable; OR-pass between sources is prohibited.
measurementPolicy.upperBodyLimit: BlazePose wrists do not expose fist shape or reliable fist rotation; punch/block definitions must not score those properties.

temporalPolicy.clock: Monotonic capture timestamps only; all durations are milliseconds, never frames.
temporalPolicy.segmentation: Use streaming phase evidence with onset/exit hysteresis; batch peak-frame heuristics are not primitive boundaries.
temporalPolicy.trackingGaps: Suspend scoring on short gaps and require reacquisition; long gaps close the attempt as tracking_lost/uncertain without a numeric score; endpoint hold time advances only while observable.
temporalPolicy.fpsGate: The same evidence resampled at supported FPS must preserve primitive count, phase order, and completion status within declared tolerance.

sideAndOrientationPolicy.canonicalSide: Persist anatomical LEFT/RIGHT only; preview mirroring and camera-relative direction are separate metadata.
sideAndOrientationPolicy.turnPolicy: Suspend limb scoring during blind turns. Confirm turns from observable pre/post orientation checkpoints, then require stable identity, scale, framing, stance, and endpoint before advancing.

voicePolicy.observationGate: Closed from cue enqueue through TTS completion/cancellation plus reactionGuardMs; frames captured while closed cannot complete the step.
voicePolicy.lifecycle: Pause observation and timers on audio-focus loss, app background, screen lock, or navigation blur; resume through explicit reacquisition.
voicePolicy.fallback: If TTS is unavailable, show deterministic text and require acknowledgement before observation.

tables.pose_evidence: optional compact landmarks governed by replay consent

offlineContract: remove local event only after server acknowledgement
persistenceArchitecture.legacyContract: Keep kicks and kick_frames unchanged; generalized results use additive tables and adapters.

scoringPolicy.coverageRule: Numeric scores require minimum observable coverage; missing evidence never deducts.
scoringPolicy.hardGateRule: A failed hard gate prevents a passing outcome and remains visible separately from the numeric score.
scoringPolicy.aggregationRule: Generalized metrics are namespaced and do not enter kick-only Fighter Attributes/goals/streaks without an explicit profile.

beginnerUxPolicy.learnMode: Allow relaxed timing and disabled speed scoring while preserving order, endpoint, and safety hard gates.
beginnerUxPolicy.correctionRule: Give one highest-priority observable correction; never correct an unobservable criterion.
beginnerUxPolicy.retryEscape: After two failed retries offer demonstration, adjust camera, retry, skip, or end.

phases.title: Voice coach foundation
scope: Offline TTS with Off / Score / Score+cue / Full modes.
Interrupt-and-speak-latest queue policy for rapid training.
Shared audio settings, pause/resume, repeat cue, and mute controls.
Short, deterministic cue vocabulary suitable for noisy gyms.
phases.whyFirst: Forms require reliable speech orchestration; this also delivers the already-planned Update 3 value immediately.

phases.title: Single punches and blocks
scope: Start with a small beginner set: jab/lead straight, cross/rear straight, high block, inward/middle block, low block.
Define stance, chamber/start, extension, alignment, endpoint, recoil/reset, torso stability, and opposite-hand discipline where visible.
Support explicit left/right and orthodox/southpaw stance selection before attempting automatic stance inference.
Add a debug/calibration view showing every criterion before hiding it in production.
limitations: Hands frequently occlude the face/torso and move faster than legs.
One camera cannot measure impact or reliably infer fist rotation in depth.
Punch/block evaluation must tolerate lower wrist visibility without inventing landmarks.

phases.title: Kick, punch, block, and mixed combinations
scope: Add technique order, timing windows, inter-move transitions, stance continuity, rhythm, recovery, and completion gates.
Begin with fixed 2-move combinations, then 3-4 move combinations.
Initial examples: jab-cross, block-cross, front-snap-cross, roundhouse-cross, jab-cross-roundhouse.
Score each move separately plus transition quality; never average away a dangerous/critical failure.
Allow practice modes: announced sequence, chosen sequence, and later free-combo recognition.

phases.title: Voice-guided basic form/pattern MVP
scope: Start with one short, mostly camera-visible beginner pattern such as Kibon/Kibon Poomsae (exact school naming and sequence must be confirmed with the user/instructor).
Preload the ordered steps as movement primitives with expected direction, stance, side, and completion pose.
Speak the next move, observe, require a short stable completion hold, then say either the next move or one corrective cue.
Controls: start, pause, repeat instruction, retry, skip step, restart, mute, and end session.
Display current step / total steps and the expected movement name without requiring the user to read during execution.
Store per-step result, retries, confidence, corrections, elapsed time, and form completion summary.
phases.advancePolicy: Advance only after cue completion, reaction guard, expected primitive commit, sufficient evidence coverage, timestamp-based stable endpoint hold, and any orientation checkpoint. Never auto-advance on uncertainty, tracking loss, unsupported view, blind turn, or stale async work.
phases.criticalRisk: Turns can hide limbs or move the body out of frame. The MVP form must use a documented camera placement and may require orientation checkpoints rather than pretending continuous full-body tracking is always available.

phases.title: Multiple forms and adaptive coaching
scope: Add school/style-specific libraries only after each sequence is instructor-verified.
Offer Learn (step-by-step), Practice (minimal cues), and Test (no cues until completion) modes.
Personalize tolerances from user history without lowering safety-critical requirements.
Add form-level metrics: order accuracy, stance consistency, timing/rhythm, balance, direction changes, and recovery.
Version every form definition so historical sessions remain interpretable when criteria change.

recommendedMvpOrder: One punch and one block with debug criteria
dataModelNotes: Do not rename, overload, or insert non-kick activities into kicks; expose legacy kicks through a generalized read adapter.
Use client-generated UUIDs and idempotent local event graphs for parent session, ordered step, attempt, and optional evidence.
Store criterion status as pass/fail/unobservable/not_applicable; score is null below minimum observable coverage.
Store anatomical side separately from camera facing, preview mirroring, rotations, and camera-relative orientation.
Store compact landmarks only with replay consent and deletion/retention controls; no video unless policy and consent change.
Form sessions contain expected steps, observed attempts, transition results, retries, corrections, skips, and one parent summary.
Historical sessions render against immutable recorded definition versions or criterion snapshots.
Generalized metrics do not enter kick-only goals/streaks/Fighter Attributes without an explicit aggregation profile.
researchAndSafetyGates: Instructor verifies every movement sequence and coaching cue before release.
Create labeled validation clips across body sizes, clothing, camera distance, lighting, stance side, and device FPS.
Calibrate thresholds from data; document heuristic weights until then.
Clearly label unsupported camera views and movements that cannot be measured reliably.
Never auto-advance on low-confidence tracking; offer retry or skip.
Ship no criterion relying on monocular depth, absolute world speed, hidden rotation, fist rotation, impact, or contact without labeled view-specific validation.
Require FPS-resampling, mirroring/side, occlusion-gap, turn/reacquisition, stale-async, offline-idempotency, and TTS-observation-race test suites before combos/forms.
Track primitive recall, non-technique false positives, side/orientation confusion, score coverage, tracking-loss rate, and cue correctness separately; one aggregate accuracy number is insufficient.
